design.audience: Players trying the two local character approaches and reviewing why an action succeeded or failed.
design.baseline_weakness: Static player polygons, courier circle and sentinel diamond show little accepted-action or contact motion; a paid failed strike has no body gesture.
design.intention: Make existing commitment, action attempts, contact ownership and recovery visibly inspectable while keeping combat rules exact.

alternatives.assessment: Adds content and encounter design without addressing the existing action feedback weakness.
Broadens choices before their current gestures are visible.
Could raise art detail, but needs asset production/curation and still requires the action/contact timing contract.

alternatives.option: Original native articulated silhouettes and event-owned gestures
alternatives.assessment: Selected: bounded direct consumer production, original editable geometry, existing tools and exact unchanged-model controls.

contracts: Read-only observer; source combat.gd, errand.gd, rehearsal.gd, sound.gd, controls.gd and keepsakes.gd unchanged.
Actual displacement drives gait; accepted cooldown edge animates a paid strike, but only counter event produces sentinel contact/recoil.
Model events own player/courier hurt and directional block. Guard eligibility still requires timing, facing and posture.
Simulation elapsed time owns animation; repeated observation, pause and frozen review cannot advance it. Replacement consumes history without replay.
Existing warning lines, pulse/range geometry and sound remain; no new full-screen flashes, shake, random particles, damage areas or immunity.
Counter is instantaneous in the model, so its gesture begins toward the actual target then recovers, rather than adding a new windup.
Worn-mark render is a prepared owned-mark fixture, not evidence of newly earned progression; existing real reward/restart controls remain unchanged.
